### Lesson
- `getBuiltinModel` generics: TProvider narrows TModelId via `keyof (typeof MODELS)[TProvider]` — widening TProvider to its constraint union forces TModelId to `never`
- Fix: either `as never` on modelId, or use non-generic `getBuiltinModels(provider).find(...)` lookup
- `as never` is acceptable when the runtime lookup tolerates any string (pi-ai's MODELS[provider]?.[modelId] does)
